info.syllabusName: Kỹ năng phòng tránh tai nạn trong công nghiệp (Industrial Safety Skills)
info.description:
Giới thiệu về an toàn, sức khỏe nghề nghiệp

Vai trò của OHS trong phát triển kinh tế - xã hội

Các khái niệm, thuật ngữ chính trong OHS

Nhận biết mối nguy và các biện pháp an toàn
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Demonstrate basic knowledge about the role of safety in industry, OSH basic concepts, risk identification and propose basic measures to prevent accidents in industry
Use knowledge about hazard identification and proposing basic measures in preventing accidents in industry
Assume for businesses the contents to be performed / services on risk identification and propose basic measures to prevent accidents in industry
Carry out research methods and assessment of risk identification and basic measures to prevent accidents in industry
Build writing skills and presenting scientific reports to present program / project content effectively.
Build teamwork skills and working independently in the learning process effectively
Develop professional ethics; comply with occupational safety principles; have good moral qualities, knowledge and compliance with laws; respect and protect workers.
